theme_and_archetype.reasoning: MoneyFlow needs to establish trust, precision, and a premium feel. We avoid generic 'fintech-bro' neon and 'childish UI'. Instead, we use deep charcoal, crisp 1px borders, and a stark, highly legible premium blue accent. This is an elite financial control center.

dashboard_balance_card.layout: Column, center-aligned if hero, left-aligned for data density
dashboard_balance_card.style_notes: Do not use drop shadows. Rely on the 1px subtle border and contrasting background for elevation. Top right corner can have a subtle blur gradient of the accent color for a premium feel.

transaction_row.style_notes: No cards per row. Flat list. Minimalist. Red/Green text only applied to the amount, not the whole row.

fab_add_transaction.style_notes: High contrast, no heavy shadows. 4px solid border of colors.background.default to make it 'cut out' from the background.

charts_section.style: Line chart for balance trends, Bar/Pie for categories
charts_section.config: Hide grid lines, hide Y-axis labels for cleaner look, use custom tooltips on press.

bottom_tab_navigation.style_notes: Keep it strictly flat. No floating dock style. Traditional bottom tab for reliable UX.

first_launch_modal.content: Currency Picker (INR default). Large tap targets.

budget_progress_card.style_notes: Use a horizontal bar chart/progress bar. Fill color shifts from green to orange to red as budget is consumed.

iconography.usage: Use stroke-based icons (Feather). Consistent stroke width (2px). Icons inside transaction rows should map to categories (e.g., Coffee, Shopping Bag, Dollar Sign).

motion_and_interactions.modals: Smooth slide-up bottom sheets for 'Add Transaction' and 'Currency Selector'
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Opacity reduction to 0.7 on active/press. Scale down slightly (0.95).

testing_and_accessibility.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include a `testID` (for React Native) AND `data-testid` (if standard React Web components are bridged). Use kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., `data-testid="add-transaction-button"`, `data-testid="currency-selector"`).
testing_and_accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. Deep charcoal background with off-white text ensures excellent readability.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use 'Inter' or 'Space Grotesk' for headings. Use 'Manrope' or high-quality System equivalents.
Build the dashboard using React Native View components with precise padding and borders as defined in spacing_and_layout.
For charts, configure react-native-gifted-charts strictly with the colors defined (accent_primary) and disable grid lines.
Implement the 'Add Transaction' FAB explicitly on the Dashboard and Transactions screens.
Ensure the first-launch currency picker sets a global state used across all currency displays.
Do NOT use generic shadows (elevation). Rely on surface color changes and 1px borders for depth.
Attach `data-testid` AND `testID` to all TextInputs, Buttons, and TouchableOpacities to ensure robust automated testing.
Create Tab navigation for Dashboard, Transactions, Insights, Budget, Settings.
